messages:
incident-bot: :pager: Paging on-call — elevated p95 latency for /v1/embeddings (eu-central-1, dedicated) observed since 18:22 UTC. Current p95=980ms (baseline 210ms). Error rate stable. Route: eu-dedicated-pool-3. Threshold breach: 3 consecutive minutes.

oncall-robin: I'm on it. taking ownership. pulling logs and metrics.

jamal: Thanks. I'm freeing up burst capacity, increasing pool by 2 nodes now.

oncall-robin: Noted. Can someone check KV cache hit rates? suspect eviction churn.

maria: KV cache hit dropped to 62% from 96% over the last 10m. Logs show increased small-sequence requests.

sara: Quick mitigation: recommend temporary TTL increase + reduce batch max_tokens to 256 on eu-dedicated to lessen cache pressure.

chen: rolling a config patch now: `PATCH /internal/configs/pool/eu-dedicated` -> `{ "batch.max_tokens": 256, "kv.ttl_secs": 7200 }`

incident-bot: Deploy started by chen (deploy-4921). ETA ~2m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

jamal: Scaling pool: `./infra scale --pool eu-dedicated --add 2 --type g5` ok

oncall-robin: Observing p95: 980ms -> 640ms after scale, KV hit up to 74% after TTL change taking effect. Still above SLO.

maria: Customer impact: several heavy-embedding customers see request tails. Estimating 12% of traffic in eu affected. No errors, just latency.

sara: Drafting status page line: "Investigating elevated latency for embeddings in eu-central-1 dedicated pools. Some customers may see degraded response times. Mitigation in progress."

liz: 👍 Please include expected next update in 30m and contact for enterprise customers.

chen: Deploy complete. routing warmed. Patch id: deploy-4921. Logs show reduced KV eviction events.

oncall-robin: p95 now 310ms. Close to baseline but still a little high on long-tail. Continuing to monitor for 15m.

jamal: Propose follow-ups: 1) increase default cache size for eu pools; 2) investigate small-sequence burst patterns; 3) consider autoscaling sensitivity.

oncall-robin: Agreed. I'll create follow-up ticket and assign to eng-runtime.

sara: Customer notification draft for affected customers:

---
Hi <Customer Team>,

We observed elevated embedding latency in our eu-central-1 dedicated inference pools between 18:22 and 19:05 UTC which may have caused slower responses for some requests. Our operations team scaled capacity and applied a temporary cache configuration change. Latency is now near normal and we will continue monitoring. No data loss or errors were observed.

If you saw persistent issues please reply and we'll investigate with higher priority.

Sincerely,
Redwood Inference Operations
---

maria: Suggest adding "impact: short-term latency increase, approx 12% of requests".

liz: Add our CSM contact and offer a post-incident analysis if needed.

oncall-robin: Marking incident as mitigated at 19:05 UTC. Postmortem follow-up ticket: RT-4123 created.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Next update scheduled 19:35 UTC. :white_check_mark:

jamal: Closing notes: root cause likely cache TTL default not tolerant to burst small sequences + conservative autoscaler ramp. Moving to eng-runtime backlog.

chen: I'll follow up with a small config tweak and a canary to avoid regression.

oncall-robin: Thanks all. If nothing regresses by 19:35 we'll archive thread. :slightly_smiling_face:
